skill.name: paper-2-web
skill.description: Convert academic papers into interactive websites, presentation videos, and conference posters using the Paper2All workflow.
skill.summary: Transforms LaTeX or PDF research papers into web, video, and poster materials for academic dissemination.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The audit found no evidence of malicious intent, prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or hidden code execution. Most static findings are documentation false positives from Markdown command examples, API key placeholders, and benign references; one elevated sudo dependency install remains a real user-consent risk.

remediation.issue: The installation guide includes a sudo apt-get command for system dependencies.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running elevated commands, and present package names as manual prerequisites when possible.

remediation.issue: The documentation asks users to create .env files containing third-party API keys.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to keep .env files out of version control and avoid pasting real keys into prompts or generated artifacts.

remediation.issue: The skill includes many shell command examples for cloning repositories and running generation pipelines.
remediation.suggestion: Separate explanatory examples from commands the agent may execute, and ask for user approval before running long, costly, or networked workflows.

- Ensure no extra spaces or quotes around keys in `.env`
- Check that API keys are valid and have sufficient credits
3. **Backing**: Foam core or rigid backing for stability
2. **Limit text**: Use bullet points, avoid paragraphs
- Custom branding requires manual specification or API access
- `--model-choice 1`: GPT-4 (best balance of quality and cost)
- Ensure LaTeX source compiles successfully: `pdflatex main.tex`
- **`references/paper2web.md`**: Detailed Paper2Web documentation with all features
- **`references/paper2video.md`**: Comprehensive Paper2Video guide including talking-head setup
- **`references/paper2poster.md`**: Complete Paper2Poster documentation with design templates
# Optional: GOOGLE_API_KEY and GOOGLE_CSE_ID for logo search

content.value_statement: Researchers need clear ways to share dense papers beyond the PDF. This skill helps Claude, Codex, or Claude Code plan websites, videos, and posters from LaTeX or PDF papers.
actual_capabilities: Guides Paper2Web workflows for interactive academic homepages.
Guides Paper2Video workflows for narrated presentation videos.
Guides Paper2Poster workflows for print-ready conference posters.
Explains input requirements for LaTeX sources, PDFs, figures, and bibliographies.
Documents model, output, and customization options for Paper2All commands.
Provides quality review checklists for websites, videos, and posters.
limitations: Requires a separate Paper2All installation and its dependencies.
Video generation with talking-head features needs a high-memory NVIDIA GPU.
Generated content still needs human review for scientific accuracy.
API-backed features require user-provided provider keys and credits.

use_cases.title: Create Conference Materials
use_cases.description: Turn a completed paper into a poster, video, and companion website for a conference deadline.

use_cases.title: Promote Published Research
use_cases.description: Create a public research homepage and short presentation assets for a lab or personal website.

use_cases.title: Prepare Paper Media at Scale
use_cases.description: Plan repeatable workflows for generating dissemination assets from multiple related papers.

prompt_templates.title: Choose the Right Output
prompt_templates.prompt: Use paper-2-web to help me decide whether this paper needs a website, video, poster, or all three. Ask me for the paper format, deadline, and audience first.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Paper2Web Site
prompt_templates.prompt: Use paper-2-web to plan a Paper2Web workflow for my LaTeX paper. Include input preparation, recommended command options, and a review checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Conference Assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Use paper-2-web to create a conference preparation plan for a 48 by 36 inch poster and a 10 minute video from my research paper.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Batch Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use paper-2-web to design a safe batch workflow for five papers. Include folder organization, component selection, resource estimates, and manual quality gates.

output_examples.input: I have a LaTeX paper and need a conference poster in two days.
output: Recommended Paper2Poster first because it is faster than video.
Prepare main.tex, figures, bibliography, poster dimensions, and institution logo.
Review readability, figure resolution, QR codes, and final print size before submission.

output_examples.input: I want a public homepage for an accepted paper.
output: Recommended Paper2Web with LaTeX input for best structure extraction.
Include abstract, key findings, figures, citations, authors, and repository links.
Test mobile layout, figure rendering, external links, and accessibility before publishing.

output_examples.input: My lab wants media packages for several papers.
output: Use one folder per paper with consistent input and output paths.
Generate websites before posters and videos to reduce deadline risk.
Schedule human review after each generated component before distribution.

best_practices: Use clean LaTeX sources with all figures, tables, and bibliography files included.
Review generated outputs for scientific accuracy before sharing or publishing.
Confirm costs, API keys, and compute requirements before running long workflows.
anti_patterns: Do not run elevated installation commands without user confirmation.
Do not publish generated materials without checking claims, figures, and author details.
Do not use scanned or low-quality PDFs when LaTeX source is available.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It helps create interactive paper websites, narrated videos, and print-ready academic posters using Paper2All workflows.

faq.question: Does it require LaTeX?
faq.answer: LaTeX is recommended for best results, but high-quality PDFs with selectable text are also supported.

faq.question: Can it generate videos without a GPU?
faq.answer: Standard video generation can run without the talking-head feature. Talking-head generation requires a high-memory NVIDIA GPU.

faq.question: Does it use external APIs?
faq.answer: Yes. The referenced workflow can use OpenAI, OpenRouter, and optional Google Search API credentials supplied by the user.

faq.question: Is the output ready to publish immediately?
faq.answer: No. Users should review all generated text, figures, links, timing, and layout before public release.

faq.question: Can Claude Code run the commands for me?
faq.answer: It can help run local commands when authorized, but installation, API use, and long jobs should be confirmed first.
